title: 煅玉堂 第七十九章 窦德真仙煅玉堂 第七十八章 危险炼丹
content_zh:
这次魔阴宫来阚芜仙域的有三位真仙大能，华依依肯定不会再理此事。那就还剩两人。两人是谁，秦凤鸣想知道。
经过与华依依一战，秦凤鸣对真仙大能的畏惧已经大大消弱。
哪怕真被真仙堵截，他也并非没有手段与之对抗。至少金波神君答应出手，金波神君经过一两千年恢复，精魂恢复到了何种地步，秦凤鸣不确定，但他既然答应，肯定有把握压制真仙大能。
否则金波神君哪里会冒险，早就劝他另谋他路了。
董迁与丁原两人无语，一名仙境修士被真仙大能惦记，在两人以前看来，就已经判那位仙境修士死刑了。但放在面前这位青年身上，会是另外一番场景。
“秦大师，见那位真仙，还是请汤巍前辈同去为好。”蓝冰不放心，提议道。
“嗯，此事还是要汤巍前辈知晓，省的误会。”秦凤鸣同意。
再次登上观云楼，进入到了汤巍所在洞府空间。
“拜见四位前辈！”秦凤鸣进入凉亭，立即冲在座的四人躬身见礼。这里依旧是汤巍、崔怀四位真仙。
“秦大师，丹药炼制出了？”崔怀真仙起身，满脸期待神色。
他留在这里，唯一目的就是等着玄牝锁阳丹，此丹修仙界极少，哪怕是青阳教以丹道立教，也已经上百万年不曾有玄牝锁阳丹出现了。
玄牝锁阳丹丹方不少丹道宗师参悟过，只要尝试炼制，无人不打退堂鼓，几乎没人炼制成功过。就是圣师，也是对玄牝锁阳丹讳莫如深，不愿沾染。
其他三位真仙不约而同也纷纷起身，没人托大。
“嗯，晚辈幸不辱命，虽然炼制过程磕绊，但终究是成功了。这是三枚丹药，三位验看。”秦凤鸣微笑，挥手就送出了三只玉瓶。
汤巍看着着秦凤鸣自信的神情，人畜无害的笑容，他实难相信，如此一位青年，曾是一位从真仙追遁中逃出之人。
“哈哈哈……果真是玄牝锁阳丹，不会有错，且药效似乎比传闻中的丹药还要强大很多，如此一枚丹药如果拍卖，怕是会拍出五万仙灵石以上价格。秦大师，需要我们付多少仙灵石，你尽可提出，崔某不还价。”
崔怀真仙大喜，笑声响彻，心中激动难抑。
“崔道友所言太保守了，如此丹药，修仙界已经不知多少万年不曾出现了，如果真要拍卖，会吸引数百上千位真仙现身，到时拍出十万仙灵石也不狂妄，小友但凡提出数字，卢某立即支付。”芦湛真仙双目溢彩闪烁，将手中丹药价值又自翻倍了。
“小友说出价格，六竺立即支付。”六竺真仙同样开口道。
“三位前辈言重了，三位当初冒险对抗三位真仙大能，晚辈感激不尽，如果没有三位前辈拼力相护，晚辈早就落入魔阴宫之人手中了，是死是活都说不定，区区几粒丹药，是晚辈聊表心意而已。提什么仙灵石，就是没有将晚辈当朋友。”

秦凤鸣脸上笑意浮现，眼中神采闪现。
他对玄牝锁阳丹看重，但没有想到三位真仙竟直接定价十万仙灵石，这价值大大超出了他意料。
“这怎么可以？这种丹药炼制无比艰难，修仙界中因为炼制此丹身负道伤之人不在少数，就是丹道圣师也没有谁敢轻易炼制此丹。小友定然也是九死一生才炼制成功的，我们岂能白白得到？”崔怀真仙真诚开口，不想白嫖秦凤鸣用性命才炼制出的丹药。
其他两人同样坚持，谁也不想领秦凤鸣这莫大人情。因果太大，三位真仙不想背负。
content_en:
This time there are three true immortals coming to Kanwu Immortal Domain from Moyin Palace. Hua Yiyi will definitely not pay attention to this matter again. That leaves two people. Who are the two people, Qin Fengming wants to know.
After the battle with Hua Yiyi, Qin Fengming's fear of the power of the true immortal has been greatly weakened.
Even if he is really intercepted by the true immortal, he is not without means to fight against it. At least Jinbo Shenjun agreed to take action. Qin Fengming was not sure to what extent Jinbo Shenjun's spirit had recovered after one or two thousand years of recovery, but since he agreed, he must be sure to suppress the true immortal power.
Otherwise, Shenjun Jinbo would not take risks, and he would have been advised to find another way.
Dong Qian and Ding Yuan were speechless. A fairyland monk was missed by a true immortal. In the eyes of the two of them, the fairyland monk had already been sentenced to death. But when it comes to the young man in front of him, it will be a different scene.
"Master Qin, if you want to see that true immortal, it would be better to invite senior Tang Wei to go with you." Lan Bing suggested, worried.
"Well, senior Tang Wei still needs to know about this matter to avoid misunderstandings." Qin Fengming agreed.
Climb the Guanyun Tower again and enter the cave space where Tang Wei is.
"Meet the four seniors!" Qin Fengming entered the pavilion and immediately bowed to the four people present. Here are still the four true immortals Tang Wei and Cui Huai.
"Master Qin, has the elixir been refined?" Immortal Cui Huai stood up with an expectant look on his face.
His only purpose of staying here is to wait for the Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill. This pill is very rare in the world of immortal cultivation. Even if the Qingyang Sect is based on the method of alchemy, there has been no Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill for millions of years.
Many alchemy masters have learned about the Xuan Mi Suoyang elixir. As long as they try to refine it, no one will be discouraged. Almost no one has succeeded in refining it. Even the Holy Master kept the Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill secret and did not want to be contaminated.
The other three true immortals also stood up at the same time, but no one supported them.
"Well, I am fortunate to have lived up to my mission. Although the refining process was bumpy, it was successful in the end. Here are three pills, please check them." Qin Fengming smiled, waved and sent out the three jade bottles.
Tang Wei looked at Qin Fengming's confident expression and harmless smile. It was hard for him to believe that such a young man had once escaped from the pursuit of a true immortal.
"Hahaha... It really is the Xuan Mi Cynomorium Pill, there is no mistake about it, and the effect of the medicine seems to be much more powerful than the rumored pill. If such a pill is auctioned, I am afraid it will fetch more than 50,000 immortal spirit stones. Master Qin, you can propose how many immortal spirit stones we need to pay. Cui will not bargain."
Immortal Cui Huai was overjoyed, his laughter resounded, and he could not suppress his excitement.
"What Cui Daoyou said is too conservative. Such elixirs have not appeared in the world of immortal cultivation for countless thousands of years. If it is really going to be auctioned, it will attract hundreds of thousands of true immortals to show up. It is not arrogant to sell one hundred thousand immortal spirit stones at that time. As long as I put forward the number, Lu will pay it immediately." Immortal Lu Zhan's eyes flashed with color, and the value of the elixir in his hand doubled.
"My little friend, tell me the price, and Liu Zhu will pay it immediately." True Immortal Liu Zhu also said.
"The words of the three seniors are serious. The three of them took the risk to fight against the three true immortals. I am very grateful to this junior. If it were not for the three seniors who worked hard to protect each other, I would have fallen into the hands of the people from the Demon Yin Palace. It is uncertain whether I will live or die. A few pills are just a token of my feelings for the junior. The mention of the Immortal Spirit Stone means that I have not regarded this junior as a friend."
A smile appeared on Qin Fengming's face, and his eyes sparkled.
He valued Xuan Ni Suoyang Pill, but he did not expect that the three true immortals would directly price it at a price of 100,000 immortal spirit stones. The value was far beyond his expectation.
"How is this possible? It is extremely difficult to refine this kind of elixir. There are many people in the world of immortality who have suffered Taoist injuries because of refining this elixir. No one, even the Holy Master of Alchemy, dares to refine this elixir easily. I must have narrowly escaped death to successfully refine this elixir. How can we get it in vain?" Immortal Cui Huai spoke sincerely, not wanting to go to waste the elixir that Qin Fengming spent his life refining.
otherBoth of them insisted that no one wanted to accept this huge favor from Qin Fengming. The cause and effect was too great, and the three true immortals did not want to bear it.
